thread:
elaine: Quick postmortem follow-up — summarizing owner assignments and timelines for last week's provider/model-registry/auth outage.

elaine: TL;DR: root cause = cloud auth token rotation mismatch + model-registry cache stampede; primary mitigations: (1) auth token backoff/refresh fallback, (2) model-registry read replicas + short-circuit cache, (3) provider-region fallback. Need owners + dates.

sam: +1. I can own (1) auth backoff + fallback. ETA 2026-04-02. Will draft runbook steps.

maria: I'll take (2) model-registry replicas + cache short-circuit. Plan: add a hot-standby read replica, implement prefix blacklist for cache on rollout. ETA 2026-04-09.

adrian: I can coordinate (3) region fallback wiring and test run. Will do a DR dry-run next week. ETA 2026-04-05.

elaine: Thanks. @sam @maria @adrian please add the individual task cards to the postmortem Jira epic and tag sprint-22-remediation.

sam: done — Jira EPIC-1223 created, I linked my subtask EPIC-1223-1. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/EPIC-1223

maria: added EPIC-1223-2 and put a TODO to add perf regression tests for cache bypass.

adrian: EPIC-1223-3 created, scheduling dry-run for 2026-03-29. @oncall-bot can you schedule an injection window for that date?

oncall-bot: @adrian scheduled: dry-run on 2026-03-29 09:30-10:30 UTC in sandbox cluster. Reminder set for 24h prior.

elaine: Action owners — please post check-in updates in this thread every 3 days until closed. I'm adding weekly gate reviews to the remediation calendar.

maria: noted. Quick question — do we keep the temporary auth soft-fallback for 30 days after deploy or until next retro? prefer 30 days.

sam: 30 days sounds right. We'll add metrics: auth-fallback-rate, failed-token-refresh, registry-cache-miss-rate.

adrian: logging/alerts: set a PAG when fallback rate > 5% sustained for 10m. I'll add that to EPIC-1223-3.

elaine: Good. Also recurring pattern note: this is 3rd time in 9 months we saw token rotation + registry caching interplay. We need a long-term owner for supply-chain resilience.

sam: agree. propose to assign a quarterly owner rotation: infra-owner-of-the-quarter. Will draft handoff doc.

maria: I'll add 'resilience signal' checks to Ops dashboard so we can spot early pattern changes.

elaine: Perfect. Final ask: everyone drop a one-line postmortem action in the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/2026-03-23-vendorchain-remediate (just the owner + ETA). Deadline: AM 2026-03-26.

adrian: done.

sam: added my line.

maria: added mine. marking EPIC-1223-2 blocked->in-progress.

elaine: Closing note: thanks all. We'll re-open if blockers come up. :thumbsup:
